messages:
nora: Hey payroll team — my March and April net pay are lower than expected. I checked paystubs and see an unfamiliar deduction labeled 'STATE TAX RECOVERY - OR' for $260 on both checks. I moved from OR to WA last year and submitted a WA withholding form in Jan. I didn't expect OR recovery.
hr_payroll: Hi Nora, can you DM the March/April paystubs and confirm the date you updated your state in Workday? We'll escalate. Do not post SSN here.
nora: DM sent with both paystubs and the Workday change log (state set to WA on 2026-01-10).
payroll-bot: Payroll batch #202604 processed for 2026-04-30; state withholding files transmitted.
payroll_ops: Thanks. Initial look: "STATE TAX RECOVERY" often means another employer or state requested recoveries for prior underpaid taxes, or a reversal of prior credits. We'll pull the state remittance files and recovery notices to identify origin.
finance_ops: If recovery was applied in error, we'll process reversal and refund on next payroll cycle and document tax/reporting effects. If it is valid, we'll provide employee proof and appeal steps.
tax-team: Also ask the employee whether they had OR employment after moving; OR has specific rules about resident/nonresident wage allocation. If you had OR wages or filed OR returns, that could explain it.
nora: I had zero OR days after 2025-12-31. Only Washington work in 2026. I uploaded my WA withholding form and lease to the secure bucket.
hr_payroll: Good — that helps. Plan: 1) Payroll Ops to retrieve recovery notice and matching remittance 2) Validate whether SSN/address match caused misapplied recovery 3) If misapplied, reverse and refund; if valid, we'll provide documentation and next steps for contesting. Expect update in 5 business days.
payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-2026-349 opened: "Investigate OR state tax recovery on Nora paystubs" (linked to thread 1795001111). Sensitive docs stored in People Ops secure bucket.
nora: Thanks, please keep me posted. This is unexpected and a bit stressful.
payroll_ops: Understood. We'll prioritize and post findings here.
finance_ops: If reversal needed, please include any bank fee reimbursement and check whether the recovery affected 2026 year-to-date tax reporting — we may need to issue a corrected W-2 if already filed.
nora: Appreciate the thoroughness — thanks everyone.
